exercises.title: Your First Robot Test
exercises.description: Create a simple test case that logs the message 'Hello Robot Framework!' to the console.
instructions: Create a test case named 'My First Test'
Use the Log keyword to print 'Hello Robot Framework!'
Remember: Use 4 spaces between keyword and argument
